_about: Each island's rules in our own words, from reading the Flash client (rules/islands.json has the numbers the game uses). Not loaded by the game: for reading.

shared.killGold: Per enemy killed: floor(cost/2) if it attacks and costs gold, floor(cost/4) if it attacks and costs stone, otherwise 0; 0 becomes 5. Then times the island's goldMultiplier, truncated to a whole number.
shared.killXp: ceil(gold x 0.05) of the gold above; 0 becomes 1 unless the item is a wall (subcat 221). Summoned enemies pay nothing.
shared.caps: After each kill, if the island total is above the cap it is set to the cap (gold and xp separately). A win bonus paid inside a kill is cut the same way; one paid outside a kill (troll chests, Dangerous Isle) is not.
shared.winBonus: bonus[stars-1] gold, and a tenth of it in xp.
shared.xpAtEnd: At the end xp is cut to at most gold/2 (truncated).
shared.recovery: At the end every killed unit is first marked recovered, then killed - ceil(killed x recovered/100) of them, picked at random, are lost. Units the island lent are then added as recovered.
shared.loss: Every own unit dead (army sent plus lent units), or leaving: results 3 s later.
shared.copies: difficulty 'copies': at 2 stars each enemy unit gets one copy at the nearest free tile, at 3 stars two. Only units on the enemy side once the island is set up (lent units aren't copied). Copies pay gold like the originals.
shared.bossStars: difficulty 'boss': no copies; the island's boss rules change the boss instead (see each island's boss object and notes). The 1.1/1.2 multipliers declared in several classes are never used.
shared.defaultSides: Items an island doesn't place on a side keep the file default: race 'n' neutral; 'e' and 'a' enemy; 'h' and 't' enemy (refuges neutral).
shared.itemRewards: Boss rewards by the player's race ('h' or 't'), sent as item_rewards {id: count} on a win only; a repeated id means more than one.
shared.stars: Star n can be picked once n-1 stars were won on that island; the default is max(1, stars won).
shared.sides: neutral: subcats that are nobody's on this island; neutralBuildingsExcept: every building but these subcats is nobody's; friendlyItems: item ids switched to the player's side. Items of race 'n' and refuges (1311) are nobody's everywhere; everything else is an enemy.

islands.100000002: Setup: every item joins the group of the nearest of four points (18,38), (18,59), (29,79), (58,78) (straight-line distance, the first point wins ties). Keys (item 146, subcat 812, four of them) fill their group's slot and show frame group+1. The Locked Gate (147, subcat 813) at (77,83) is the door. The Giant Yeti (545, subcat 84, life 15000) is already in the file at (92,83). Enemy units join their group; other buildings stay enemies outside any group; deco, atrezzo and the stable (331) are neutral. Free: the file's Wizard (550) and four Powerful Knights (541). Step 1: when a group's last unit dies, its key becomes collectable. Only grouped units pay gold (plain formula); other enemies pay nothing. Step 2: collecting a key removes it, the counter ('keys left') goes down, and three Penguins (546) join the player near the key (nearest free tiles to key+(1,1), key+(-2,1), key+(1,-2)). For every key but the last, the gate shows its next frame and the three penguins are lent units (alive count +3, given back at the end). Step 3: the last key removes the gate and hides the counter. Difficulty, set on Start Battle: 1 star as is; 2 stars yeti life x2 (attack unchanged); 3 stars life x2 and a second Giant Yeti at the nearest free tile to (yeti x, yeti y+3), also x2. Win: kill the yeti (both at 3 stars): bonus, results 5 s later. Reward to storage on a win: humans a Powerful Knight (541), trolls a Battle Troll (596). Original quirks not worth copying: the second yeti is built from stats already doubled, so it ends at x4 life (and repeat visits in one session compound); the start-up count only adds the penguin entry (0), so the Wizard and the knights are left out of the alive count; the last key's penguins are neither counted nor given back.

islands.100000018: Sides: every unit is an enemy (the heroes in the file are not lent), towers (211) are enemies, every other item (walls, doors, deco) is neutral. Win: kill every enemy unit (units marked as converted don't count down; 2-3 star copies do): bonus, results 3 s later. Doors: seven zones in doorZones as [x1,y1,x2,y2], inclusive; each unit and each Wall Door (37, subcat 222) belongs to the first zone that holds it, and a door opens when its zone's last unit dies. Per-kill gold is x0.0625, truncated (the 5-gold minimum becomes 0; xp is still at least 1). Original quirks: anything killed that has no zone (towers, 2-3 star copies, units outside every zone) counts against zone 0 and can open its door early; the win check runs after every kill once the count is 0, so the bonus can be paid twice if more units die before the results.

islands.100000011: Setup: groups by quarter: x<50 and y<50 is 0, x>=50 and y<50 is 1, x<50 and y>=50 is 2, x>=50 and y>=50 is 3. Activators (subcat 812) fill their quarter's slot: Braziers (287) at (5,5), (95,4), (4,97), (95,95). The Skeleton (258) at (5,91) is in quarter 2 too and is replaced there by the brazier listed after it, so it never matters. Group members: every item of troll ('t') or enemy ('e') race, units and buildings alike (the two troll houses too), and boss adds (subcat 85). Deco and atrezzo are neutral; the rest keep the file's sides (the human heroes and towers are enemies outside any group and pay nothing). Counter: braziers to activate. Step 1: when a quarter's group is all destroyed its brazier becomes collectable (not once the boss is out). Only grouped items pay gold. Step 2: collecting a brazier removes it and the counter goes down. Step 3: the fourth brings the Rockdriller (566, subcat 84, life 10000) to the nearest free tile to (49,49), with its sound. Difficulty is applied then: 1 star life x0.8; 2 stars life x2; 3 stars life x2 and a second Rockdriller at the nearest free tile to (boss x+3, boss y), also x2. Attack unchanged. Win: kill it (both at 3 stars): bonus, results 5 s later. Reward to storage on a win: humans three Powerful Archer Knights (574) and a Rockdriller Skull (288); trolls three Ravager Trolls (600) and the skull. Original quirk: the second rockdriller is built from stats already doubled, so it ends at x4 life (and repeat visits in one session compound).
islands.100000033: The bonus is the Nest Isle's (Quest GOLD_REWARD_ISLA_DRAGON). Background black. Every item in the file is neutral except huge eggs; no gold or xp for any kill. Set up at start: two neutral rocks (945) at (29,43) and (31,43) block the path; Golden Dragon Bosses (739) at the nearest free tiles to (12,90) and (16,79), the Deadly Dragon Boss (740, drawn at double size) near (79,33), all with aggro range 20 (25 for the black one if its picture isn't ready yet); eight Huge Eggs (434, enemy) at the nearest free tiles to the points in boss.eggs. Stats by stars: golden dragons attack 40/45/50, speed 4/5/6, life 8000/10000/12000; black dragon attack 100/120/140, speed 7/8/9, life 30000; eggs life 5000/7000/9000. Hitting an egg calls the black dragon to it. Killing both golden dragons: after 1.5 s the camera pans to (30,45) and 2 s later both rocks are removed. Each egg destroyed wounds the black dragon by 30000/8-100 = 3650. Win: the eighth egg moves the camera next to the black dragon and 1.5 s later it dies: bonus (paid outside a kill, so not cut by the cap), results 3 s after that. Killing the black dragon in a fight does not win by itself. No copies. No item rewards (an empty item_rewards is sent).
